description: Defines functions and operators related to media codecs, metadata, and stream info in the starboard namespace, including parsing video codecs and output operators for media metadata structures.

methods.name: GetMediaAudioCodecName
methods.description: Returns the name of the specified audio codec.

methods.name: GetMediaVideoCodecName
methods.description: Returns the name of the specified video codec.

methods.name: GetMediaAudioConnectorName
methods.description: Returns the name of the specified audio connector.

methods.name: GetMediaPrimaryIdName
methods.description: Returns the name of the specified primary ID.

methods.name: GetMediaTransferIdName
methods.description: Returns the name of the transfer ID.

methods.name: GetMediaMatrixIdName
methods.description: Returns the name of the matrix ID.

methods.name: GetMediaRangeIdName
methods.description: Returns the name of the range ID.

methods.name: GetMediaAudioSampleTypeName
methods.description: Returns the name of the audio sample type.

methods.name: GetMediaAudioStorageTypeName
methods.description: Returns the name of the audio storage type.

methods.name: ParseVideoCodec
methods.description: Parses a video codec string into its components, filling default values when parsing fails.
